reviews.body:
@pcbeingused333 thanks, the fix is correct: after `fit(train, val_df=val)`, `ds`, `last_dates`, `uids` and the dataset are identical to fitting the concatenated frame with `val_size=24`, for pandas, polars, integer `ds`, unequal training lengths and shuffled `val_df` rows. `predict_insample` and `cross_validation(df=None)`, which both failed on `main`, now work, and so do save/load and `fit(df=None)`. A few changes to the test, see the inline comments.

Please also update the test command and the "Testing and validation" section of the description once the test has moved.

review_comments.body: Please move this test into `tests/test_core.py`, next to `test_val_df_equivalence_with_val_size` (the existing `val_df` tests), instead of a new file.

The issue also names `cross_validation(df=None)`, which pairs `self.ds` with the stored dataset too. On `main` it fails with `IndexError: index 276 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 240`, and on this branch it works. Please add `nf.cross_validation(df=None, n_windows=1, step_size=12)` after the fit and check it returns one row per series and horizon step, so both paths that read `self.ds` are pinned.

The `assert_array_equal` on the line above already fixes the length, so this adds nothing. Please drop it, or replace it with a check that `nf.last_dates` equals the last date of each series in `expected`.
